# Microsoft BASIC for 6502 ROM Asset

`examples/j6510_basic_demo/msbasic_osi_rom.h` contains a generated byte array
for OSI Microsoft BASIC for 6502 from `mist64/msbasic`.

Source repository:

```text
https://github.com/mist64/msbasic
```

Pinned source revision used for this asset:

```text
2a0bc2fe0db13f8cf1b5c40b1d5617263cdb9cb4
```

Build command used from the source checkout:

```sh
./make.sh
xxd -i -n kMsBasicOsiRom tmp/osi.bin
```

Generated ROM:

```text
tmp/osi.bin
size: 7906 bytes
sha256: 3fbb052d13d376cc8b7d2d72a45f386deafa88a5bc0fa1a74d6b69b2352f14c3
```

The upstream `mist64/msbasic` README states the project license as 2-clause BSD.
